name: OpenRCA
intro: OpenRCA 从 AIOps Challenge 的三个真实企业系统中筛选1,753条故障记录，经规模平衡得到412条，再由三名工程师统一格式、校准标签并过滤为335个故障案例，配套68.5GB指标、日志和追踪。每题要求从遥测中识别故障时间、根因组件和根因原因的一个子集，并以全部目标要素精确匹配计算准确率。
org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Microsoft, Tsinghua University
build_method: 系统筛选, 数据平衡, 三名工程师数据校准, LLM查询合成与人工核验
metric: 严格根因准确率（时间、组件、原因全部匹配）
modality: 文本, 时间序列指标, 日志, 追踪图
task_type: 根因分析, Agent诊断, 开放式结构化预测
eval_feature: 七种根因目标, 68.5GB异构遥测, RCA-agent程序合成执行, 全要素精确匹配
modality_en: Text, Time-series Metrics, Logs, Trace Graphs
task_type_en: Root-cause Analysis, Agent Diagnosis, Open-ended Structured Prediction
build_method_en: System Selection, Dataset Balancing, Three-engineer Data Calibration, LLM Query Synthesis and Human Verification
eval_feature_en: Seven Root-cause Goals, 68.5 GB Heterogeneous Telemetry, RCA-agent Program Synthesis and Execution, All-element Exact Match
intro_en: OpenRCA selects 1,753 failure records from three real enterprise systems in the AIOps Challenge series, balances them to 412, and uses three engineers to standardize, calibrate, and filter them into 335 failure cases with 68.5 GB of metrics, logs, and traces. Each task asks for a subset of failure time, root-cause component, and root-cause reason, and accuracy requires all requested elements to match.
scale_en: 335 failure cases; 68.5 GB and 523M telemetry lines
metric_en: Strict Root-cause Accuracy (all requested time, component, and reason elements match)

drawio_review_note: Aligned with ICLR 2025 Sections 2.2-2.4, 3, and 4 plus the official microsoft/OpenRCA repository. The diagrams preserve the four-stage construction from AIOps Challenge data: selecting Telecom, Bank, and Market systems with 1,753 records; balancing to 412; standardizing names and formats; three-engineer telemetry-grounded calibration and filtering to 335; 68.5 GB and 523M lines of de-identified metrics, logs, and traces; seven goals formed from subsets of time, component, and reason; specification-based LLM query synthesis with a thirty-minute window and human verification; structured JSON answers; sampling or RCA-agent execution; and one-or-zero strict accuracy requiring every requested element to match.
